PRIVACY

Your information. Your journey.

Browsing this website

This website uses no advertising trackers and does not store passenger or payment details. No advertising or analytics scripts are added by this website’s own code. Fonts are served locally. The hosting service may receive standard technical connection data.

Making a reservation

The reservation page embeds the company’s Acuity Scheduling calendar. When you use that calendar, information is provided directly to the booking provider and the company under the notices and terms displayed there. Your payment details are not handled by this website’s own code.

Contacting us

The contact form prepares an email in your own email application. It does not send a message or retain a copy on this site. For questions about your information, contact martinezlogisticsllc@gmail.com.
